Erw Steel Pipe
What Are ERW Pipes
ERW welded steel pipe stands for Electric Resistance Welded welded steel pipe, a type of steel pipe that is manufactured using the ERW process.
ERW welded steel pipes are commonly used in various applications such as oil and gas pipelines, water transmission, structural support, and industrial machinery. They are known for their high strength, excellent weldability, and cost-effectiveness. These pipes are available in various sizes, thicknesses, and grades to suit different requirements and are widely used in the construction and manufacturing industries.

Youfa produces welded carbon steel pipes widely used across industries due to its strength, cost-effectiveness, and adaptability.

Why Choose Youfa As Your ERW Tube Supplier ?
High-Quality Products:
Youfa is known for producing high-quality ERW tubes that meet industry standards and specifications. We strictly adheres to standards (state on the PI) in the production and inspection process. This dedication to standards can provide customers with confidence in the consistency and reliability of Youfa’s ERW tubes for their projects and applications.
Wide Range of Products:
Youfa offers a wide range of ERW tubes in various sizes, shapes, and specifications to meet the diverse needs of different industries and applications.
Customization Options: 
Youfa can provide customized solutions to meet specific requirements, including different coatings (galvanizing, oiling, painting, 3PE FBE) and lengths.
Reliable Supply Chain:
Youfa has a reliable supply chain, large production capacity (13 factories in China) and distribution network, ensuring timely delivery of products to meet your project deadlines.
Environmental Responsibility: 
Youfa is committed to environmental responsibility and sustainability in their manufacturing processes, making them a responsible choice for environmentally conscious customers. Certified by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Youfa is a "Green Industry" enterprise.
